items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did almost all of Tunji’s dates. Nick might have been on one of them.

ctx.x: Tell me about Joseph Casavubu and Patrice Lamumba.

Years ago there was a trumpet player by the name of Nick Travis. He used to – we used to call each other Deedle-ee and Nicholai and stuff like that. One time, a cat named Olatunji, a bass – a conga player, called – let’s see. How – I don’t remember how this actually went down. But he called – I don’t know how it was, but he insulted . . .
